assembly_notes: Front must slide before electronics; removing it later requires withdrawing boards.
Approach from the rear parallel at 0.8 mm lift, then lower onto supports. Top edges need no empty component strip.
Rear stops are only 0.6 mm high above PCB bottom, below the assumed 1.6 mm PCB top. Gravity and end stops locate boards; upward movement is intentionally not clamped.
Wall spacer rings must be installed on wall screws first; do not fix them to the moving keyhole panel. Their small holes cannot pass screw heads.
Screwdriver and finger access are not proven by nut solid clearance.
